name: clawplays/ospec
summary: 据发布者介绍，ospec 可将编程需求整理为规格说明，引导 AI 编程智能体完成规划、实现和验证，并将规格说明与验证记录保存在代码仓库中。

The publisher describes ospec as a framework for turning coding requests into specifications, guiding AI coding agents through planning, implementation, and verification, and keeping the specs and verification evidence in the repository.
